description: Just inside the main gate at about 36.3925N 136.4210E; the only one of the six not moved in 2026
Moved with the rest of the display line to the ground west of the main gate around Feb-Mar 2026
Early F-86F-25 with wing fences carrying former 4 Sqn markings; the blog has a separate note arguing about this airframe's registration year
In the display area beside the road; the whole area is sometimes closed on air festival days for want of guards
Fin-shaped monument erected to mark the 30th anniversary of 306 Sqn; not a real airframe and no serial is recorded
